tagline: 美能达取景器相机，1987 年发布
description: 美能达于1987年推出的取景器相机。配备35 mm f/4,5.。使用Automatic loading, advance and rewind. Continuous shooting mode available.。感光度1,5—3,2 m.。Fixed focus from 1,5 m to infinity.。

specs.对焦: Fixed focus from 1,5 m to infinity.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, automatically activated with ready-light in finder. Shutter locked while recharging.
specs.曝光测光: EV 9,6–16,2 with ISO 100 film. Narrow metering angle.
specs.胶片/画幅: Automatic loading, advance and rewind. Continuous shooting mode available.
specs.英文简介: Minolta FS-E II (called Freedom 100 in America) is a fixed-focus compact camera, largely based on the AF-E II.
